gv.leave.body: Your changes here haven't been saved and will be lost.
gv.log.title: Activity log
gv.log.intro: Every privileged change in this organization: who did it, when, and what changed. Newest first, 50 at a time.
gv.log.since: The log starts on {date}. Changes made before that day aren't in it.
gv.log.sinceNoDate: The log starts on the day it was introduced. Changes made before that day aren't in it.
gv.log.orgIdHint: Paste an ID and press Enter
gv.log.loadedOnly: Action and person filter the entries already read. “Show more” reads older ones.
gv.log.noneSoFar: Nothing matches in the entries read so far. Older ones may: use “Show more”.

gv.act.sso.switch: School sign-in switched on or off for the platform

gv.pol.title: Who can join with a code
gv.pol.intro: These rules are checked when someone joins with an invite code. People you add yourself are not checked.
gv.pol.verifiedHint: Only people who opened the link in their confirmation email can join with a code.
gv.pol.domainsHint: Only addresses on one of these domains can join, for example school.edu. The match is exact: school.edu doesn't let pupils.school.edu in. With no domains, any address can join.
gv.pol.domainsTip: An address that isn't confirmed proves nothing about its domain. Switch on “Require a confirmed email address” as well.
gv.pol.domainBad: That doesn't look like a domain. Write it like school.edu.
gv.pol.noDomains: No domains: any email address can join.
gv.pol.expiresHint: The code stops working when that day ends. Empty: it never expires.
gv.pol.expiryPast: Choose today or a later day.
gv.pol.maxUses: Most people who may use it (optional)
gv.pol.maxUsesHint: After that many people have joined with it, the code stops working. Empty: no limit.
gv.pol.noCode: This organization has no such code yet. Make one first.
gv.pol.renewed: This is a new code: it starts with no last day and no limit. Set them again here if you want them.
gv.pol.removedHint: Someone you removed can't come back with a code, or through your school's sign-in, until you let them back in. Letting them back in doesn't add them (they join again with a code), except an account your school's sign-in made or matched: that one goes straight back in as a student.
gv.pol.readmitted: {name} can join with a code again.
gv.pol.readmittedSchool: {name} can join with a code again, and your school's sign-in no longer keeps them out.
gv.pol.readmittedBack: {name} is back in the organization as a student, and your school's sign-in opens the account again.
gv.pol.back.otherOrg: {name} belongs to another organization now, so they can't be let back in here. They stay on this list.
gv.pol.back.staff: {name} is a platform admin, and platform admins never use a school's sign-in. They stay on this list.
gv.pol.back.orgInactive: This organization isn't active, so nobody can be let back in.
gv.legal.intro: The privacy notice and the terms of use: everyone can read the published versions, and new sign-ups are asked to accept them.
gv.legal.lawyer: Darsi supplies no wording. The text of both pages must come from your organization's lawyer.
gv.legal.notPublished: Not published: nobody is shown this page or asked to accept it.
gv.legal.textHint: Plain text, at most {max} characters. Line breaks are kept. So far: {n}.
gv.legal.others: This page also has text in other languages ({langs}), which stays as it is.
gv.legal.draftSaved: Draft saved. Nothing changed for readers.
gv.legal.needEnglish: Write the English text before publishing: other languages fall back to it.
gv.legal.publishBody: Everyone will see this version; new sign-ups will be asked to accept it.
gv.legal.unpublishBody: It is taken off the public page and nobody is asked to accept it any more. The draft stays.
gv.legal.fileFailed: This was recorded, but the public page could not be updated, so readers still see what was there before. Do the same again to update it.
gv.ret.intro: How long each kind of record is kept before the nightly clean-up deletes it. An empty field means: kept until deleted by hand. Darsi sets no period: each one is your decision. Accounts, learning records, projects and payments are never deleted here.
gv.ret.bad: A whole number of days from 1 to 3,650, or empty.
gv.ret.p.bugReportsClosedDays: Problem reports, after they are fixed or closed
gv.ret.h.bugReportsClosedDays: A report's words, details and screenshot, counted from the day it was marked fixed or closed.
gv.ret.h.bugReportsAnyDays: Every report and its screenshot, counted from the day it was sent, even one nobody has looked at yet.
gv.ret.h.analyticsDevicesDays: The random ID that lets usage be counted per phone, counted from the phone's last active day. A phone that comes back later counts as a new one.
gv.ret.h.checkoutsOpenDays: Checkouts that were started or failed and never paid. Paid and refunded ones are always kept. Keep these longer than a payment provider may take to confirm a payment.
gv.ret.h.joinAttemptsDays: The count of invite-code tries per account, which stops codes being guessed.
gv.ret.h.auditDays: The activity log itself, the platform's and every organization's, including the entries about deleted accounts and about this clean-up. Entries that say a course was published are kept: they hold each course's version number.
gv.ret.h.orgExportsDays: The files made when an organization's data is exported, which wait to be downloaded.
gv.ret.previewTitle: What these periods would delete now
gv.ret.would.bugReports: This would delete {n} now: problem reports, with their screenshots
gv.ret.would.analyticsDevices: This would delete {n} now: analytics device IDs
gv.ret.would.checkouts: This would delete {n} now: abandoned checkouts
gv.ret.would.joinAttempts: This would delete {n} now: join-try counts
gv.ret.would.audit: This would delete {n} now: audit entries
gv.ret.would.orgExports: This would delete {n} now: organization export files
gv.ret.partial: Counting took too long, so the real numbers may be higher.
gv.ret.nightly: The clean-up runs every night and deletes at most 500 records of each kind per run, so a large backlog takes several nights.
gv.ret.confirmBody: The nightly clean-up will start deleting the records counted above. Deleted records can't be brought back.
gv.ret.confirm: Save and let the clean-up delete them
gv.ret.lastFailed: These kinds failed and will be tried again the next night: {list}
gv.ret.lastStopped: It ran out of time. The rest follows the next night.
gv.stat.buildHint: The build of the app open on this device.
gv.stat.errsHint: App errors that phones reported today and yesterday (days in UTC), by the build they were running.
gv.stat.errsNone: No errors reported today or yesterday.
gv.stat.incomplete: Late: the last run didn't finish
gv.stat.attentionHint: Among the newest {n} log entries: a web address that stopped working, an organization renamed or re-branded while it has its own address, and payments that couldn't be matched or applied.
gv.stat.cspHint: What the report-only policy would have blocked, by directive. These are running totals, not one day's.
gv.bug.deleteBody: The report and its screenshot are removed for good.
gv.bug.deleted: The report and its screenshot were deleted.
